note: THE block registry. Every block — built or defined — is one entry here. The folder (blocks/<name>/) is the source of truth for a built block's CODE; this file is the source of truth for the block's EXISTENCE, links, and contract summary. Validated by _kernel/check-catalog.ts (runs in npm test); rendered to CATALOG.md by _kernel/render-catalog.ts. Edit JSON, never the rendered md.

schema.name: kebab-case, unique. For operations: a VERB phrase.
schema.grain: infrastructure (a noun the app needs) | operation (a verb the app does with data)
schema.status: built (folder exists, tests run) | defined (catalog card only — mined, evidenced, not yet code)
schema.cluster: grouping for humans; operations share their mined cluster
schema.classes: invariant classes A-D the block's gates instantiate (operations only; see classes below)
schema.invariant: the load-bearing guarantee, as mined — this becomes the gate set when built
schema.port: {in, out} stated WITHOUT domain words (the grain-2 litmus: if you cannot name the types domain-free, it is a feature, not a block). null for infrastructure (port.ts in the folder is authoritative).
schema.buildsOn: names of catalog blocks this one composes on (ports it consumes). Conservative: only edges the mining itself asserted.
schema.evidence: repos in which this op recurs — the reuse proof

A.name: conservation-under-allocation
A.gate: consumed_once AND allocated <= available AND sum(allocations) == total

B.name: fail-closed-verification-against-pinned-authority
B.gate: verify_against_pinned(x) OR reject — unknown/expired/garbled is never assume-valid

C.name: events-to-reproducible-verdict-in-bounded-window
C.gate: verdict == f(events within window), reproducible — never a stored flag, never a bare delta

D.name: derived-total-from-one-canonical-formula
D.gate: total == formula(parts), recomputed — one formula the whole system trusts
